name: Can handrails be installed on curved staircases?

mainEntity.name: Can handrails be installed on curved staircases?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, handrails can be installed on curved or spiral staircases, though these installations are typically more complex than straight runs. Custom fabrication is often required to match the unique curvature of the staircase precisely. This may involve bending wood or metal components to fit the contours, ensuring a continuous and secure grip. The process demands specialized skills and measurements to achieve both safety and aesthetic integration. We have experience handling complex installations like curved handrails.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, handrails can be installed on curved staircases, but it often requires custom fabrication and specialized skills due to the unique curvature.
